We have employed 16 workers who are fluent in both Korean and English to check the quality of the machine translation of sampled questions and answers. Each worker checked the quality of 8 question-answer pairs per question type. Each pair was checked by at least two workers. Workers compared the original and the translated texts, and gave scores to four statements on a 5-point Likert scale, with 1 being disagree/bad and 5 being agree/good. The statements were: 1) I can understand the translation, 2) The translation has similar meaning to the original text, 3) The translation contains grammatical and lexical errors, and 4) Overall translation quality.
